Soul City Cycling Monday Encouragement Ride

Jackson, MS · Road

Beginner friendly

Soul City Cycling Monday Encouragement Ride is a road group ride in Jackson, MS. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm. About 20 miles, all levels, ride your own pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all levels, ride your own pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Soul City Cycling Monday Encouragement Ride group ride

A Monday night out-and-back of about 20 miles with 457 feet of climbing. Riders from beginner to fast all come and ride at their own pace. Bring a chair for afterward. The start point is posted in the Soul City Cycling Facebook group.
